001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.controller;
002
003import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
004import android.app.Dialog;
005import android.content.res.Resources;
006import android.os.Bundle;
007import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
008import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
009import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
010import androidx.fragment.app.DialogFragment;
011import androidx.navigation.Navigation;
012import androidx.navigation.fragment.NavHostFragment;
013import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
014import java.util.Arrays;
015import java.util.stream.Collectors;
016
017/**
018 * ExplanationFragment is a subclass of DialogFragment that displays an alert dialog
019 * explaining the reason for requesting specific permissions. The message is dynamically
020 * constructed based on the permissions passed to the fragment.
021 *
022 * The permissions to be explained are provided as arguments to this fragment and are
023 * extracted during initialization. These permissions are then converted to corresponding
024 * string resource names, and the associated text resources are fetched and compiled
025 * into a readable explanation message for the user.
026 *
027 * A parent fragment must implement the OnDismissListener interface to handle the dismissal
028 * of the dialog. This callback ensures that the parent fragment is notified when the dialog
029 * is dismissed.
030 *
031 * Key Features:
032 * - Dynamically generates explanatory messages for permissions.
033 * - Provides an AlertDialog to present the explanation.
034 * - Notifies the parent fragment when the dialog is dismissed via a callback interface.
035 *
036 * The fragment requires the parent context to provide permission explanation string resources
037 * in the format `<permission_name>_explanation`.
038 */
039public class ExplanationFragment extends DialogFragment {
040
041  private String[] permissionsToExplain;
042
043  @Override
044  public void onCreate(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
045    super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
046    ExplanationFragmentArgs args = ExplanationFragmentArgs.fromBundle(getArguments());
047    permissionsToExplain = args.getPermissionsToExplain();
048  }
049
050  // TODO: 3/28/25 figure out how to convert strings into permissions to explain
051  //  into the names of string resources, so I can look those up and provide regular text.
052
053  // TODO: 3/28/25 Can try getIdentifier in Resources class. 3 params context (requirecontexT) and ...
054  //  name of resource, type of resource, package of the resource context.getpackagename
055
056  @NonNull
057  @Override
058  public Dialog onCreateDialog(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
059    Resources resources = getResources();
060    String packageName = requireActivity().getPackageName();
061    @SuppressLint("DiscouragedApi") String message = Arrays.stream(permissionsToExplain)
062        .map(permission -> permission.substring(permission.lastIndexOf('.') + 1))
063        .map(String::toLowerCase)
064        .map(permission -> permission.replace('.', '_'))
065        .map(permission -> permission + "_explanation")
066        .mapToInt(permission -> resources.getIdentifier(permission, "string", packageName))
067        .mapToObj(resources::getString)
068        .filter(string -> !string.isEmpty())
069        .collect(Collectors.joining("\n"));
070
071    OnDismissListener listener =
072        (OnDismissListener) getParentFragment().getParentFragment();
073
074    return new AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
075        .setTitle(R.string.permissions_explanation_title)
076        .setIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_dialog_info)
077        .setMessage(message)
078        .setNeutralButton(android.R.string.ok, (dialog, which) -> {
079          listener.onDismiss(); // Tell activity we are done
080        })
081        .create();
082  }
083
084  /**
085   * Interface definition for a callback to be invoked when a dismiss event occurs.
086   *
087   * Implement this interface to handle the dismissal of a dialog or similar component.
088   */
089  public interface OnDismissListener {
090
091    void onDismiss();
092
093  }
094}
